WITH RECURSIVE
  seed AS (
    SELECT subject_id AS module_id
    FROM module_depends_on_package
    WHERE object_id = 'package:fx14-legacy'
  ),
  closure AS (
    SELECT module_id FROM seed
    UNION
    SELECT d.subject_id
    FROM module_depends_on_module d
    JOIN closure c ON d.object_id = c.module_id
  )
SELECT module_id FROM closure ORDER BY module_id

  ),
  prod_services AS (

    JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sd ON sd.subject_id = s.service_id
    JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd ON ttd.object_id = sd.object_id

FROM prod_services ps
JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sd ON sd.subject_id = ps.service_id
GROUP BY ps.service_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sd.object_id) > 1

WITH RECURSIVE
  seed AS (
    SELECT subject_id AS module_id
    FROM module_depends_on_package
    WHERE object_id = 'package:fx14-legacy'
  ),
  closure AS (
    SELECT module_id FROM seed
    UNION
    SELECT d.subject_id
    FROM module_depends_on_module d
    JOIN closure c ON d.object_id = c.module_id
  ),
  affected_services AS (
    SELECT sim.subject_id AS service_id, sim.object_id AS module_id
    FROM service_implements_module sim
    JOIN closure c ON sim.object_id = c.module_id
  ),
  RECURSIVE module_to_l1 AS (
    SELECT module_id, module_id AS l1_root
    FROM seed
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.subject_id, m.l1_root
    FROM module_depends_on_module d
    JOIN module_to_l1 m ON d.object_id = m.module_id
  )
SELECT a.service_id, a.module_id, m.l1_root
FROM affected_services a
JOIN module_to_l1 m ON m.module_id = a.module_id
ORDER BY a.service_id

WITH RECURSIVE
  package_modules AS (
    SELECT subject_id AS module_id
    FROM module_depends_on_package
    WHERE object_id = 'package:fx14-legacy'
  ),
  affected_modules AS (
    SELECT module_id FROM package_modules
    UNION
    SELECT d.subject_id
    FROM module_depends_on_module d
    JOIN affected_modules am ON d.object_id = am.module_id
  ),
  affected_services AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sim.subject_id AS service_id
    FROM service_implements_module sim
    JOIN affected_modules am ON sim.object_id = am.module_id
  ),
  production_services AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.service_id
    FROM affected_services a
    JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sd ON sd.subject_id = a.service_id
    JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd ON ttd.object_id = sd.object_id
    WHERE ttd.subject_id = 'task:fx14-cutover'
  )
SELECT service_id FROM production_services ORDER BY service_id

WITH RECURSIVE
  package_modules AS (
    SELECT subject_id AS module_id
    FROM module_depends_on_package
    WHERE object_id = 'package:fx14-legacy'
  ),
  affected_modules AS (
    SELECT module_id FROM package_modules
    UNION
    SELECT d.subject_id
    FROM module_depends_on_module d
    JOIN affected_modules am ON d.object_id = am.module_id
  ),
  module_l1 AS (
    SELECT module_id, module_id AS l1_root
    FROM package_modules
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.subject_id, ml.l1_root
    FROM module_depends_on_module d
    JOIN module_l1 ml ON d.object_id = ml.module_id
  ),
  affected_services AS (
    SELECT sim.subject_id AS service_id, sim.object_id AS module_id
    FROM service_implements_module sim
    JOIN affected_modules am ON sim.object_id = am.module_id
  ),
  production_services AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.service_id
    FROM affected_services a
    JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sd ON sd.subject_id = a.service_id
    JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd ON ttd.object_id = sd.object_id
    WHERE ttd.subject_id = 'task:fx14-cutover'
  ),
  service_l1 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.service_id, ml.l1_root
    FROM affected_services a
    JOIN module_l1 ml ON ml.module_id = a.module_id
    JOIN production_services ps ON ps.service_id = a.service_id
  ),
  shared_l1 AS (
    SELECT l1_root
    FROM service_l1
    GROUP BY l1_root
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT service_id) > 1
  )
SELECT DISTINCT sl.service_id
FROM service_l1 sl
JOIN shared_l1 s ON s.l1_root = sl.l1_root
ORDER BY sl.service_id
